name: 89815 · Spring Creek, NV
findings: ZIP 89815 (Spring Creek) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89815 (Spring Creek) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89815 (Spring Creek) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).
